title: Trehalose Preserves Soluble LmOx During Repeated Freeze-Thaw Cycles Without Increasing Catalytic Turnover
authors: Celia Yara, Bram Cole, and Nia Fenn | Synthetic Formulation Laboratory
research_question: Does trehalose preserve soluble LmOx during repeated freeze-thaw cycles, and does it change specific activity?
key_findings: 10% trehalose preserved 84% soluble LmOx versus 41% without trehalose
Specific activity remained 118-123 U/mg and did not increase
10% was the lowest concentration at the recovery plateau
conclusion: Trehalose improved physical recovery, not catalytic turnover.
forbidden_claims: The experiment was performed at pH 6.0
